newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Norish says pretax profit 1.6 mln punts.
newsitem.headline: Norish says pretax profit 1.6 mln punts.

text.p: Norish Plc said on Thursday that pre-tax profit was 1.649 million Irish pounds for the year to December 31, 1996.
This compares with a loss of 6.85 million in 1995, the group said in a results statement.
It announced earnings per share of 16 pence compared with a loss of 68.7 pence in 1995 and said net assets per share recovered to 44.6 pence from 27.7 pence in 1995.
Norish said a rationalisation and disposal programme was completed in 1996.
"Since then we have taken the opportunity to effect a refinancing of our debt somewhat earlier than originally anticipated," it said.
Norish, who did not recommend a dividend for 1996, said demand for space in the UK market was very strong and storage rates have increased significantly compared with a year ago.
"The strong demand is expected to continue in 1997 as is upward pressure on strorage rates.
